text: Poor glycemic control with increased thirst and elevated random glucose is noted.
Type 2 diabetic patient has raised fasting glucose and blurred vision.
Blood pressure remains high on repeated checks with dizziness.
Hypertensive patient reports headache and elevated clinic blood pressure.
The impression is chronic kidney disease with high creatinine and low eGFR.
Abnormal renal function and proteinuria support kidney disease.
Liver enzymes are elevated with fatty liver changes and jaundice history.
Chronic liver disease is suspected due to raised bilirubin and AST ALT values.
Low hemoglobin and exertional weakness are typical of anemia.
Anemia is recorded with pallor and reduced blood count values.
Raised LDL and abnormal lipid profile indicate high cholesterol.
Persistent hyperlipidemia with elevated triglycerides supports high cholesterol.
TSH abnormality with thyroid medication review indicates thyroid disorder.
Weight change, fatigue, and altered T3 T4 suggest thyroid disorder.
Gastritis is likely because of acidity, reflux, and epigastric burning.
Upper abdominal discomfort with acid peptic symptoms suggests gastritis.
